theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ U, (x ∈ T.support ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → R.measure (ball x ε) ≠ 0)) ∧ ∀ R' : IMRep U n, R'.Represents T → R'.measure = R.measure) → (∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → n ≤ d → d ≤ P → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) ∧ (N = univ → ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), ball y R ⊆ U → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) ∧ (∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ U, HasMassDensity T y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U) ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity T y θ → 1 ≤ θ) → (∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (x : Euclid (n + k)) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n), StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C) → ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (z : Euclid (n + k)) (r : ℝ) (RT : IMRep U n) (𝓜 : Set (Measure (Euclid (n + k)))), 0 < r → closedBall z (2 * r) ⊆ U → RT.Represents T → (∀ μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k)), μ ∈ 𝓜 ↔ (∃ (a : Euclid (n + k)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t ∧ t ≤ r ∧ dist a z ≤ r - t ∧ μ = ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n) • (RT.measure.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation a t)) ∨ ∃ (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (RS : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (b : Euclid (n + k)), (∀ i, dist (cs i) z < r - ts i) ∧ Tendsto ts atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto cs atTop (𝓝 b) ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S ∧ RS.Represents S ∧ μ = RS.measure) → ∀ dens : Measure (Euclid (n + k)) → Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, (∀ (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (x : Euclid (n + k)), dens μ x = (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal) → (∃ μ₀ ∈ 𝓜, ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + k)) 1, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity T (z + r • w) θ → dens μ₀ w = θ) ∧ ∀ ν ∈ 𝓜, ν univ = ∞ → ∃ (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i), (∀ i, xs i ∈ ball z r) ∧ Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S ∧ IsMinimizingIn S univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S ∧ ∀ y, HasMassDensity S y (dens ν y)
